messages:
maggie: Quick PSA — a couple Windows folks (Ruby 3.2 + Bundler) can't get the ruby-sampleapp quickstart running, `bundle install` fails with OpenSSL/native extension errors.

alex: ugh. can you paste the exact error? maybe a missing dev lib on Windows or RubyInstaller step skipped.

jordan: Windows tends to need the devkit / openssl dev package. We should add a note to the README and maybe a detection in the bootstrap script.

maggie: paste of the snippet from their console: ```
Fetching openssl-3.0.8.gem
Building native extensions. This could take a while...
ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.

current directory: C:/wsl/ruby/gems/openssl/ext
mkmf.rb can't find header files for openssl.\n```

alex: yep — that's the classic one. For RubyInstaller users the fix is `ridk install` and choose MSYS2+MINGW, or `ridk install 3` to get openssl headers. For MSYS pacman: `pacman -S mingw-w64-x86_64-openssl`.

jordan: Could we detect the failure in `bin/setup` and give a friendlier message with the exact command to run? If windows and missing headers, print the `ridk` suggestion and a link to docs.

sam: Agree. Also we should add a short Windows troubleshooting section to quickstart and add a tiny GH Actions step on windows-latest to `bundle install` so CI catches regressions.

maggie: I'll open a tiny PR: add README section, catch `mkmf` failure in `bin/setup` and print guidance, and add a `bundle install` job on windows-latest matrix. Drafting now.

alex: for the message in `bin/setup` you can do something like: ```ruby
begin
  system("bundle install")
rescue => e
  if e.message.include?("mkmf") || e.message.include?("openssl")
    puts "It looks like OpenSSL headers are missing. On Windows run: `ridk install` and select MSYS2+MINGW or run `ridk install 3`. See <link> for details."
  end
  raise
end
```

ci-bot: FYI — adding windows runner will add ~5m to CI for that job; consider caching gems.

maggie: noted, will add actions/cache for bundler. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/42 — includes README + bin/setup message + GH Actions job.

jordan: nice, will review. please add a one-line test that runs `bundle install --jobs 2` to the job so we actually exercise native build path.

maggie: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — this should reduce onboarding friction for Windows folks.

maggie: closing loop — PR merged and release note added to quickstart changelog.
